infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Rydr uses your location during a live ride so other riders in your group can see where you are and hazard reports can be pinned accurately.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Rydr can keep sharing your position with your ride group when the app is backgrounded, so live tracking doesn't stop the moment you switch apps mid-ride.
